integrity: The normal form is proved directly from the cotangent multiplication and annihilators on each truncated coordinate branch. Exhaustive finite-field enumeration is used only as a consistency check. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The characteristic-zero specialization is encompassed in principle by general characteristic-zero automorphism-group theory for finite-dimensional monomial algebras; the additional claim is the explicit arbitrary-field normal form and its finite-field consequences.
No uniqueness claim about the literature is made; older work using fiber-product or Artinian Stanley--Reisner terminology may contain an equivalent positive-characteristic description.
title: Automorphisms of truncated coordinate-cross algebras over arbitrary fields
